name: io.github.tonyyang0504/resend-mcp
description: Resend (messaging): me, send, list_inbound. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_RESEND_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Resend team API key (re_…), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer re_xxxxxxxxx' (https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/introduction).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_RESEND_SENDER
environmentVariables.description: Verified-domain sender address used as `from` on every send ('Sender email address', 'Name <email@domain>' allowed; https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/send-email). Env: PLATFORM_MCP_RESEND_SENDER.
